searchText: Sigma Prime validators are down. Thanks everyone! Teku validators are stopped now <@!402853454126776320> we have a teku+catalyst databases with journaled transactions that the bug we've mentioned yesterday could be reproduced. If you want to take a closer look into it let me know and I will send you those databases and instructions how it could be reproduced. Basically you would just need to run teku+catalyst which you already tried and trigger block production by curl'ing a block production endpoint. <@425572898787426305> are you getting a trace of the execution by some clever method or just added verbose logging directly in the Catalyst code? I haven't done anything yet 🙂 But was planning to manually add trace to the `assembleBlock` handler and run this again after re-building Catalyst I don't think there is a way to make Catalyst print trace during assembling a block At least gas spent by each transactions is the same during assembling and processing a block. And it might require more detailed investigation. <@!425572898787426305> thanks! is it possible to trigger the bug by sending the curl calls to my node?(lighthouse + geth) for example, you have the signed transaction, so that in theory I can run this tx locally <@!402853454126776320> this happened with prysm as well, so I guess it's a bug in catalyst, but you may need to import the right beaconchain dbase to pair with this catalyst We have geth database with journaled transactions in it. I guess you may try lighthouse beacon node instead of teku Yeah, your beacon node node should start with the same eth1 block height as <@!755590043632140352>'s catalyst database to make beacon node work properly
